# Independent prebuild review of all 66 chat surfaces

**Verdict: BLOCKED.** No candidate instances were read or generated by this reviewer. All 66 initial constructions were reviewed. The initial split uses labels rather than disjoint canonical state programs; two target entailments are invalid and a third source scope should be clarified.

## Required corrections

- Make the stitching roster exhaustive or team membership exclusive before asserting that a transport-team member is absent from stitching.
- State that the named person actually performs inspection; responsibility alone does not entail personal performance.
- Explicitly scope both arrival/departure roles to the same location rather than adding the location to the departure answer.
- Merge equivalent state programs and allocate entire canonical groups to one split before any instances. The review does not equate every broad copy/lookup task; selective update, source precedence, conjunctive place/cause recall and other genuinely different compositions remain separate.
- Add explicit fact/event/query semantics (or a reviewed program registry) so independent interpretation is not merely template-string equality.

The snapshot and SHA256 in review-v1.json preserve the reviewed prebuild source; later corrections need a separate followup record. The 48/16 minimum should not be met by renaming equivalent templates. No quality/admission PASS is issued.

## Required equivalence groups

- value_retention_rendering: recall/identifier-recall, recall/format-recall, recall/quoted-identifier
- apology_removal_preserve_reason: fulfillment/polite-decline, fulfillment/grounded-apology
- missing_destination_then_dispatch: clarification/missing-destination, clarification/missing-decision
- agent_object_location_voice: transformations/condense-notice, transformations/active-voice
- single_binding_overwrite: corrections/destination-change, corrections/custodian-change, corrections/quantity-amendment, corrections/rename-object
- binary_binding_lookup: facts/storage, facts/responsibilities, facts/material-record, facts/capacity-record, facts/access-condition, recall/paired-recall

| Surface | Original split | Review |
| --- | --- | --- |
| fulfillment/service-notice | train | Actual two-sentence notice includes outage and available collection; followup correctly reverses sentences without changing facts. |
| fulfillment/volunteer-invitation | train | Produces invitation, task/place and joining contact; formal revision adds no schedule or unsupported activity. |
| fulfillment/equipment-reminder | train | Reminds named borrower to return compass and case; revised item ordering is correct. |
| fulfillment/safe-order | train | Securing empty stand precedes sign placement; holder of fasteners retained; explanation restates supplied ordering rather than inventing a safety mechanism. |
| fulfillment/availability-update | train | Separates ready-for-inspection object from object still awaiting assembly; followup retains both statuses. |
| fulfillment/polite-decline | train | Direct refusal and supplied reservation reason; apology removed in second answer. Same construction as development grounded-apology. |
| fulfillment/grounded-explanation | train | Sleeve prevents rubbing in transit; separation-versus-counting answer is supported by supplied purpose. |
| fulfillment/two-stage-plan | train | Actually gives the two requested steps in order; predecessor answer identifies seam inspection. |
| fulfillment/grounded-apology | validation | Preserves delay, missing part and unavailable estimate; apology removal overlaps training polite-decline. Named recipient is not addressed explicitly, a minor fulfillment weakness rather than fabricated fact. |

| fulfillment/thank-you | validation | Expresses thanks for the specified latch repair only; warmer revision does not invent other help. |
| facts/storage | train | Correctly binds two objects to different locations and retrieves the other binding; binary-lookup canonical group required. |

| facts/route-order | train | Correct successor and terminal-location queries on the given three-stop list. |

| facts/capacity-record | train | Copies supplied numeric attributes without arithmetic; other-object query is binary lookup. |

| corrections/add-member | train | Adds second inspector while preserving first; not replacement. |

| transformations/combine-facts | train | Retains actor/action bindings and correctly reverses clause order. |

| clarification/missing-decision | validation | Same missing destination -> supplied choice -> dispatch program as training missing-destination; alternatives are a variant, not disjoint construction. |
| recall/identifier-recall | train | Retains supplied identifier without arithmetic; value-retention/rendering group. |
| recall/paired-recall | train | Retains two person-object assignments and reverses retrieval order; binary-binding lookup group. |
| recall/sequential-recall | train | Arrow rendering and predecessor query preserve the given action sequence. |
| recall/format-recall | train | Copies value inside delimiters then into sentence; same construction as development quoted-identifier. |
| recall/two-item-list | train | Exact ordered slash-delimited pair and correct second-item recall. |
| recall/reason-recall | train | Retains supplied postponement cause; does not invent alternatives. |
| recall/distinguish-input | train | Preserves requested versus recorded identifier and retrieves original, not later recorded value. |
| recall/draft-not-action | train | Produces actual draft, then honestly distinguishes in-chat text from external delivery. |
| recall/reason-and-place | validation | Recalls both destination and cause; this conjunctive two-relation task is meaningfully richer than cause-only recall. |
| recall/quoted-identifier | validation | Copies identifier in quotes then sentence; cross-split duplicate of format-recall/value-retention group. |
| recall/noted-limitation | validation | Separates known assembly from missing inspection evidence; cannot infer passing status. |

Remaining candidate checks: independent state/event interpretation, renderer support for every instance, complete-history alignment, masks/counts/hashes, canonical and normalized duplicate relationships, deterministic cap selection and whole-history refusals. Root alone performs private/current-development custody.
